summary: Relaxing tapping game! Tap away correctly to unblock the hidden images!
description:
Tap Gallery is the ultimate Tap It Away game where you test your brain and tap away blocks to uncover hidden images. This IQ game is similar to Hexa Away games, where you need to tap on the arrow on tile in the correct order. Unblock amazing images on a variety of topics: animals, people, everyday life, nature, culture, household items, fantastic artifacts and much more. Unpuzzle them all! Tap Gallery is a wonderful tap puzzle in the best traditions of brain and logic games!

Key Features:

– Challenging Puzzles: Swipe away blocks and solve everyday tap puzzle to reveal stunning images. Every level presents a new and exciting Tap It Away puzzle!
– Engage Your Brain: Move blocks in the correct order to unblock the path and solve intricate puzzles. It’s a great game for brain exercise and improving your problem-solving skills
– Satisfying Gameplay: Tapping away blocks feels rewarding and relaxing, making Tap Gallery one of the best anxiety relief games
– Boosters and Power-Ups: Use special boosters to clear more tiles and finish puzzles faster. It’s all about strategy and brainpower
– Endless Fun: With a wide variety of levels, Tap Gallery offers endless puzzle-solving opportunities. As you progress, the challenges become more difficult, making it perfect for puzzle lovers

How to play:

– Tap Blocks to Solve Puzzles: Tap on the tiles with arrows to move them.  
– Strategize Your Moves: Plan your taps carefully to clear the blocks in the most efficient way possible. The more you play, the more you improve your puzzle-solving skills
– Use Boosters: When stuck, tap it away with the help of boosters to remove multiple blocks at once
– Master the Game: Become a tap master by completing increasingly difficult tap puzzles and unlocking new levels of brain-teasing challenges. Gameplay as Hexa Away allows unblock images

If you love puzzles, iq games, or addicting games that challenge your mind, Tap Gallery is for you. Download today and become a master at solving these unique puzzles in this unique tapping game!
